name: notebook
description: Notebook-first interaction for ordinary GitHub repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Work with a repository as a conceptual notebook
interface.longDescription: Foreground human/AI thinking, specifications, arguments, decisions and results while keeping files, issues, pull requests, Actions and artifacts as the ordinary GitHub machinery underneath.
defaultPrompt: Open this repository as a conceptual notebook.
Continue the most relevant notebook thread in this project.
Use the current notebook page to decide what should happen next.
